mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash, status FROM account_user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, email, password_hash, status FROM account_user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT is_staff FROM account_user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM account_user WHERE is_staff = 1 AND id IN #{i}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_profile (user_id, first_name, middle_name, last_name, birth_date, nationality) VALUES (#{userId}, #{firstName}, #{middleName}, #{lastName}, #{birthDate}, #{nationality})
mapper.update: UPDATE account_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE account_user SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_security_event (user_id, type, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{at})
mapper.select: SELECT type, created_at AS at FROM account_security_event WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at > #{since} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT created_at FROM account_user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE account_user SET last_login_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_email_code (email, purpose, code_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{purpose}, #{codeHash}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{ttlMinutes} MINUTE))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_email_code WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND created_at > DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)

SELECT id, code_hash, attempts, expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS expired, consumed_at IS NOT NULL AS consumed, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS age_seconds FROM account_email_code WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, code_hash, attempts, expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS expired, consumed_at IS NOT NULL AS consumed, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS age_seconds FROM account_email_code WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE account_email_code SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE account_email_code SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_session (user_id, token_hash, ip, user_agent, created_at, last_seen_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{ttlHours} HOUR))
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, s.last_seen_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS idle_seconds FROM account_session s JOIN account_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE account_session SET last_seen_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), expires_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{ttlHours} HOUR) WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE account_session SET revoked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
